title: Tactical Tridents
description: Your trident needs an upgrade. Unlock the netherite trident and an arsenal of new enchants.
body:
> This mod is 100% human created. ❤️

It looks like parts of this description have been redacted! Guess you're going to have to find out what they say on your own.

Adds a new trident and many new enchants.
Netherite trident:
- Does more damage
- Allows the trident to work in [redacted] when used with [redacted] in the nether.

Hydroscopic enchantment:
- Allows riptide to be used anywhere, anytime. Found by fishing in a [redacted] biome. Also [redacted] when used with impaling.

More enchantments to be discovered by looting!
